staff.releaseNotes:
- Real-time push notifications for patient/invoice creation (both apps)
- Improve background update reliability; add patient/invoice notifications (both apps)
- Instant Dashboard/Analytics revisits + consistent PageLoader (both apps)
- Show update notification without opening the app; reduce Play Protect confusion
- Restore developer credit in Android update modal (both apps)
- Show a system notification when a new Android update is available
- Show real code changes in Android What's New instead of placeholder text
- Code-split page routes to speed up initial page load
- Modernize PageLoader design (used by Superadmin Control and other pages)
- Fix broken LATEST version chip text in Android update modal
- Improve update-check loader design
- Modernize Android Update Required modal design
